description: The complete interface implemented by ob, the OpenBindings reference tool. One unbound contract describing everything ob does: creating, inspecting, editing, validating, comparing, and invoking OpenBindings interfaces, plus context storage and environment management. This document carries no bindings or sources; it is the single source of truth from which the per-surface realizations (CLI via usage, server via OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/MCP) are derived, so they cannot drift. An operation that realizes a published OpenBindings interface is keyed by that interface's operation name (e.g. openbindings.kv-store.set), so satisfaction needs no alias; ob's own operations are keyed under the ob namespace (e.g. ob.syncInterface). Aliases appear only where one operation satisfies more than one published interface, as listFormats does.
name: ob

openbindings.ob.addOperationAlias.description: Declare satisfaction alias(es) on an operation (OBI-T-12) and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.assessCompatibility.description: Assess whether a candidate interface conforms to a target interface and produce a report: per-operation input/output slot status, overall conformance level, and coverage. A report, not a binary verdict.

openbindings.ob.bindOperation.description: Attach a source ref to an existing operation (preserving the operation's key) and return the modified interface. Warns and optionally scaffolds transform stubs on a shape mismatch.

openbindings.ob.codegen.description: Generate a typed invoker for an interface in a target language (TypeScript or Go). The output is an invoker over the cardinality-agnostic handle, not a cardinality-specific client.

openbindings.ob.compareInterfaces.description: Structurally compare two interfaces (or one interface against what its sources produce) and report the differences per operation and metadata field, including cross-source drift.

openbindings.ob.conform.description: Scaffold a target interface so it conforms to a reference interface: add the operations the reference requires and reconcile mismatches, returning the updated target and a report of each change. With dryRun, reports the changes without applying them.

openbindings.ob.createDelegate.description: Register a delegate by the location of its OpenBindings interface (an exec: or http(s) URL). ob resolves the delegate's OBI and records which format-handling capabilities it offers — invoke (binding-invoker), create (interface-synthesizer), inspect (source-inspector) — and the formats it handles, so ob can route work it can't handle natively to the delegate. A delegate satisfies whichever subset it implements; an invoke-only delegate is valid. Returns what was discovered; registration succeeds with a warning when the delegate is unreachable or offers no delegatable capability.

openbindings.ob.createOperation.description: Add an operation with the given key to an interface and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.createSource.description: Register a binding source reference on an interface and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.deleteContext.description: Delete the stored context for a key. Deleting an absent key succeeds.

openbindings.ob.deleteDelegate.description: Unregister a delegate by its location.

openbindings.ob.deleteOperation.description: Remove one or more operations and their bindings from an interface and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.deleteSource.description: Remove a source reference from an interface and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.demo.description: Start the bundled demonstration servers (HTTP and gRPC) that showcase one interface satisfied across multiple binding formats. A foreground, environment-local operation, like startServer; not meaningfully invoked over a remote transport.

openbindings.ob.describe.description: Return identity and metadata about ob: name, version, description, homepage, repository, maintainer.

openbindings.ob.detachOperation.description: Convert a source-owned operation into a hand-authored one (so pull no longer overwrites it) and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.getContext.description: Get the stored context for a key. Returns the unified context payload (credentials, headers, cookies, environment, metadata in a single opaque map), or null when no context exists for the key.

openbindings.ob.getDelegateRequirements.description: Return the published interface a delegate must satisfy to provide a capability (invoke → binding-invoker, create → interface-synthesizer, inspect → source-inspector), so a prospective delegate can be checked against the exact contract (e.g. via assessCompatibility). The interfaces are immutable documents bundled with this ob release.

openbindings.ob.getEnvironmentStatus.description: Report a snapshot of the active OpenBindings environment (the .openbindings/ directory): whether it is local or global, its path, and counts of the delegates and contexts it holds.

openbindings.ob.getInterfaceStatus.description: Report an interface's status against its sources: per-source sync state (in-sync, managed, what a sync would change) and the managed-vs-hand-authored breakdown of its operations and bindings. Read-only — distinct from syncInterface (which re-derives and writes) and from compareInterfaces with fromSources (which reports raw differences).

openbindings.ob.initializeEnvironment.description: Initialize an OpenBindings environment (the .openbindings/ directory) and return its status.

openbindings.ob.inspectSource.description: Inspect a binding source artifact and report the bindable targets it contains, before any interface is created. Lets tooling show a user what an artifact offers.

openbindings.ob.invokeBinding.description: Invoke a resolved binding via a typed bidirectional I/O frame stream (the binding-invoker frame protocol). The caller streams BindingInvokerInputFrame messages (one `open` carrying the BindingInvocationInput, zero or more `input`, one `close`); the service streams BindingInvokerOutputFrame messages back (zero or more `output`/`input_closed`, then exactly one terminal `complete` or `error`). One shape covers unary, server-streaming, client-streaming, and bidirectional bindings; cardinality is observed by how the caller drives the frames. Missing runtime context fails with a terminal CONTEXT_REQUIRED error carrying ContextRequiredDetails, before any output and any side effect.

openbindings.ob.invokeOperation.description: Invoke an operation on an interface via a typed bidirectional I/O frame stream (the operation-invoker frame protocol). Unlike invokeBinding, the caller names an operation (or a specific binding) on a supplied interface, and the invoker resolves the name, selects a binding, validates against the operation's schemas, applies its transforms, and drives the underlying binding invoker. The frame shape mirrors invokeBinding exactly: one `open` carrying the OperationInvocationInput, then input frames and a close; output frames plus a terminal complete or error. Cardinality is observed, not declared, so a request/response and a streaming binding can satisfy the same operation identically. Missing context fails with a terminal CONTEXT_REQUIRED error before any side effect.

openbindings.ob.listContexts.description: List non-secret metadata summaries for all stored contexts; never returns secret values. Completes the context surface with listing and inspection: the generic kv-store substrate these contexts are stored under (satisfied by getContext/setContext/deleteContext) standardizes only opaque get/set/delete, so this management view is ob's own.

openbindings.ob.listDelegates.description: List the registered delegates with the capabilities and formats each provides. Capabilities (invoke/create/inspect) and formats are discovered from each delegate's OBI.

openbindings.ob.listFormats.description: List the binding formats this instance can handle. One operation satisfies the listFormats slot of every interface that has one, since the answer is the same regardless of which capability is asking.

openbindings.ob.listOperationAliases.description: List the satisfaction map — each operation and the interface operations it satisfies via aliases.

openbindings.ob.listOperations.description: List the operations on an interface, optionally filtered by tag.

openbindings.ob.listSources.description: List the source references on an interface.

openbindings.ob.mergeInterfaces.description: Selectively apply changes from one interface (or from the target's own sources) into another, and return the merged interface alongside a report of what was applied and skipped.

openbindings.ob.newInterface.description: Create an empty interface document (core fields + empty operations map) and return it.

openbindings.ob.prepareBinding.description: Preflight a binding: report the context it would require before invocation, without invoking it or causing side effects. Returns ContextRequiredDetails the runtime can resolve proactively, or null when requirements cannot be determined statically. Advisory; invokeBinding's reactive CONTEXT_REQUIRED error is authoritative. When context is supplied, reports only the requirements still unsatisfied by it.

openbindings.ob.prepareOperation.description: Operation-level preflight: report the context invoking an operation would require, without invoking it or causing side effects. The by-reference counterpart to prepareBinding. Resolves the named operation (or binding) on the supplied interface to a concrete binding and reports that binding's ContextRequiredDetails, or null when requirements cannot be determined without invoking. Returning null is always conformant. Advisory: invokeOperation's reactive CONTEXT_REQUIRED is authoritative. When context is supplied, the result reports only the requirements still unsatisfied by it.

openbindings.ob.pullSource.description: Derive operations and bindings from registered sources into the interface — create on first pull, overwrite + prune source-owned objects on later pulls, leave hand-authored objects untouched. Returns the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.removeOperationAlias.description: Withdraw satisfaction alias(es) from an operation and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.renameOperation.description: Rename an operation and update every reference to it (bindings, aliases) across the interface. Returns the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.resolveDelegate.description: Report which registered delegate handles a given format, and the capabilities it offers for it.

openbindings.ob.resolveInterface.description: Resolve an OpenBindings interface from a URL or host. Performs well-known discovery, follows redirects, and synthesizes an OBI from a raw binding spec (e.g. an OpenAPI document) when the target is not already an OBI. Returns the interface and metadata about how it was resolved.

openbindings.ob.setContext.description: Create or replace the context for a key. The supplied value fully replaces any existing context (full replacement, not partial update).

openbindings.ob.setDelegatePreference.description: Set a delegate's selection preference (higher = more preferred; 0 is the baseline, negatives rank below it). With no capability, sets the delegate-level default for all its offerings; with a capability (optionally scoped to a format), sets a per-offering override — how create can route to one delegate and invoke to another. Selection follows OBI-T-09: effective preference is the per-offering value, else the delegate-level value, else 0.

openbindings.ob.setMetadata.description: Edit an interface's top-level metadata (name, version, description) and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.startMCPServer.description: Serve one or more interface URLs as an MCP server, exposing their operations as MCP tools over stdio or HTTP. A foreground, environment-local operation, the MCP sibling of startServer; not meaningfully invoked over a remote transport.

openbindings.ob.startServer.description: Start a local server that exposes ob's operations over HTTP (and the binding-invoker frame protocol). A foreground, environment-local operation; not meaningfully invoked over a remote transport.

openbindings.ob.synthesizeInterface.description: Create an OpenBindings interface, optionally from binding source artifacts. Given one or more sources (e.g. an OpenAPI spec, a CLI usage spec), extracts operations, schemas, sources, and bindings into the new OBI; with no sources, produces an empty interface to author by hand.

openbindings.ob.unbindOperation.description: Remove a binding from an operation without removing the operation, and return the modified interface.

openbindings.ob.updateOperation.description: Edit an existing operation's fields (description, idempotency, deprecation, schemas, tags) and return the modified interface. A source-owned operation requires own=true (detaches first).

openbindings.ob.validateInterface.description: Validate an OpenBindings interface document against the specification. Reports whether it is valid, the declared spec version, and any problems. With strict mode, rejects unknown fields and requires a supported version.

operation.description: The operation's key or any existing identifier.

force.description: Overwrite an existing binding for this operation and source.

inputTransform.description: Inline JSONata transforming operation input to binding input.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

outputTransform.description: Inline JSONata transforming binding output to operation output.

transformStub.description: Scaffold identity transform stub(s) on shape mismatch.

operationKey.description: Suggested operation key for this target.

ref.description: Reference within the source identifying this target.

BindingContext.description: Opaque runtime context for invocation, typically sourced from a context store. Well-known credential fields: bearerToken, apiKey, basic (username/password), accessToken/refreshToken/expiresAt for OAuth. Well-known transport fields: headers/cookies/environment (string-valued objects) and metadata. Implementations and callers MAY add fields; drivers SHOULD ignore fields they don't recognize.

BindingInvocationInput.description: Initial payload carried by the open frame: identifies the binding to invoke and provides context.

BindingInvokerInputFrame.description: One frame from the caller into invokeBinding. The caller streams: exactly one `open` first (carrying the BindingInvocationInput), then zero or more `input` frames, then exactly one `close`.

oneOf.description: Open the invocation. MUST be the first frame on the input stream.
oneOf.title: open

oneOf.description: Write one input value to the underlying binding. The value's schema is the underlying operation's, not this contract's.

value.description: One input value, opaque at this layer.

oneOf.title: input

oneOf.description: Caller signals no more input frames will be sent. Idempotent.
oneOf.title: close

BindingInvokerOutputFrame.description: One frame from the service back to the caller. Zero or more non-terminal frames (`output`, `input_closed`) followed by exactly one terminal frame (`complete` or `error`).

oneOf.description: One output value from the underlying binding. Opaque at this layer.

value.description: One output value, opaque at this layer.

oneOf.title: output

oneOf.description: The binding has closed the input side from its end. Subsequent caller input frames are ignored. Outputs may still flow.
oneOf.title: input_closed

oneOf.description: Terminal: the binding completed normally. MUST be the last frame.
oneOf.title: complete

oneOf.description: Terminal: the binding failed. MUST be the last frame. Carries a structured InvocationError.
oneOf.title: error

language.description: Target language for the generated invoker.

package.description: Go package name (Go only; default derived from the interface name).

fromSources.description: Compare the baseline against what its binding sources produce.

only.description: Scope to a specific source key (requires fromSources).

ConformAction.description: A single change conform made or would make to the target.

action.description: scaffold (add a missing operation), replace (update a drifted one), skip, or compatible (already conforms).

operation.description: The operation key the change concerns.

ConformInput.description: conform input: `interface` is the reference contract whose operations `target` must satisfy; `target` is the interface scaffolded to conform, returned modified as `interface` in the result.

dryRun.description: Report the changes without applying them.

modified.description: Whether the target was changed (false under dryRun or when already conformant).

Context.description: Opaque per-target context payload: credentials, session state, headers, cookies, environment, metadata, or any other invoker-managed state. Well-known fields include bearerToken, apiKey, basic, headers, cookies, environment, metadata.

ContextRequiredDetails.description: The details payload of a CONTEXT_REQUIRED error, and the return shape of prepareBinding. Enumerates the context the invoker needs. `alternatives` are disjunctive (satisfy ANY one); the requirements within an alternative are conjunctive (satisfy ALL). This OR-of-AND shape captures semantics such as 'OAuth2 OR (apiKey AND clientCert)'.

target.description: The target the binding addresses; the runtime derives a storage key from it.

ContextRequirement.description: One prerequisite that must be satisfied before invocation, resolved into context. `type` names the requirement family (e.g. auth.bearer, auth.oauth2, auth.basic, auth.apiKey, approval.user, config.value); remaining fields are type-specific. A runtime dispatches each requirement to a resolver registered for its type.

durable.description: Whether resolved context MAY be cached under the challenge key and reused (true; e.g. credentials), or MUST be satisfied freshly each time (false; e.g. a one-shot approval). Defaults to true.

ContextSummary.description: Non-secret metadata about a stored context entry. Never includes secret values.

loadError.description: Set if the entry could not be parsed.

url.description: Context store key (normalized API origin or other stable identifier).

CreateDelegateResult.description: What ob discovered when registering the delegate. Registration succeeds even when the delegate is unreachable or offers nothing delegatable; reachable is then false and capabilities/formats are empty.

name.description: Display name resolved from the delegate's OBI, or derived from its location.

reachable.description: Whether ob could resolve the delegate's OBI at registration.

CreateInterfaceSource.description: A binding source to extract operations from.

embed.description: If true, embed content inline in the output interface.

location.description: Location to fetch content from (path or URL).

name.description: Key for this source in the output interface's sources.

outputLocation.description: Location to reference in the output interface's source.

aliases.description: Satisfaction aliases — other interfaces' operation keys this operation also answers to (OBI-T-12).

idempotent.description: Whether the new operation is idempotent.

input.description: JSON Schema for the new operation's input.

output.description: JSON Schema for the new operation's output.

DelegateCapability.description: A format-handling capability a delegate provides, mapping to the interface it satisfies: invoke (openbindings.binding-invoker), create (openbindings.interface-synthesizer), inspect (openbindings.source-inspector). A delegate offers whichever subset it satisfies.

description.description: Human-readable description of the format, when the delegate provides one.

format.description: Format token the delegate handles (e.g. grpc, openapi@3.1).

location.description: Delegate location: the exec: or http(s) URL of the delegate's OpenBindings interface.

DelegateSummary.description: A registered delegate and what it provides, discovered from its OBI.

builtin.description: True for ob's own native handling — the implicit self-delegate, delegate 0.

capabilities.description: The format-handling capabilities the delegate offers.

location.description: The delegate's location (exec: or http(s) URL); absent for the builtin self-delegate.

operation.description: The operation's key or any identifier.

DiffReport.description: The differences between two interfaces (or an interface and what its sources produce). Empty operations, metadata, and drift means they are identical.

contextCount.description: Number of stored contexts in this environment.

delegateCount.description: Number of registered delegates in this environment.

InterfaceInput.description: Wraps the interface document an operation acts on.

InterfaceStatus.description: An interface's read-only status against its sources: per-source sync state plus the managed-vs-hand-authored breakdown of its operations and bindings.

InvocationError.description: Structured error carried by an error output frame. Indicates terminal failure of the invocation.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. ERR_CANCELLED, ERR_VALIDATION_FAILED, ERR_PROTOCOL, CONTEXT_REQUIRED).

details.description: Optional structured details specific to the code. For CONTEXT_REQUIRED, a ContextRequiredDetails object.

location.description: Location of the binding source (path or URL).

operation.description: Scope the satisfaction map to a single operation.

ManagedKeys.description: Keys split by provenance: managed (derived from a source by sync) vs hand-authored.

MergeEntry.description: One operation-level change in a merge, and whether it was applied.

action.description: The merge action for this entry (e.g. add, update, conflict).

operation.description: The operation key the change concerns.

excludeOperations.description: Exclude these operations from the merge.

fromSources.description: Derive the source side from the target's own binding sources.

noBindings.description: Don't graft bindings (operations and their referenced sources still come).

noSources.description: Don't graft source entries (operations and bindings still come).

only.description: Scope to a specific source key (requires fromSources).

opsOnly.description: Graft operations only (no bindings or source entries) — the adopt-keys satisfaction strategy.

openbindings.description: Target OpenBindings spec version; defaults to the tool's max tested version.

Operation.description: An operation definition as it would appear in an interface.

OperationAliasEntry.description: An operation and the interface operations it satisfies via aliases.

OperationCompatibility.description: Compatibility for a single operation, with per-slot status.

matched.description: Whether a matching operation exists in the candidate.

OperationInvocationInput.description: Initial payload carried by invokeOperation's open frame: the interface to act on and which operation (or specific binding) to invoke, plus context.

binding.description: Binding key to invoke; the operation is derived from it. Mutually exclusive with operation.

operation.description: Operation key to invoke. A binding is selected automatically.

OperationInvokerInputFrame.description: One frame from the caller into invokeOperation. Same shape as the binding-invoker input stream, with the open frame carrying an OperationInvocationInput: exactly one `open` first, then zero or more `input` frames, then exactly one `close`.

oneOf.description: One output value from the operation.
